verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies region selection. A release note says a model can be imported into OCI Generative AI in a named region (UAE Central, Abu Dhabi), and one community comment says Oracle will support configurations 'in any region globally.' Nothing documents choosing a storage region for data generally or offering residency guarantees. missing for 10: first-party docs on region selection for data storage, a list of available regions, data-residency or sovereignty commitments, controls that keep data within a region, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You can now import the zai-org/GLM-5.3 model into OCI Generative AI in the UAE Central (Abu Dhabi) region
Oracle will build and support whatever configurations you want in any region globally
